svg.title: Seaweed
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Photographed at Philadelphia in 2026, with explicit 1949 painting/caption. Thin branching painted lines represented as filled vector strips; distressed off-white field and brushtexture simplified. Entire painted rectangular canvas retained; frame omitted. Physical size unresolved in primary catalogue. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
